title: pvm podman container template
description: One podman container template, built per-template via `podman exec`+`commit` (no Dockerfile) and run per-project bound to the cwd. Provisioned from the shared provision-asset cache ivm/qvm use. See IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md.

template_name.description: Template id - the `<template>` you pass to `pvm init <template>`. NOT the container name: that is `pvm-<template>-<project>`, where <project> is derived from the cwd, and the cwd binding is stored in the `pvm.project_dir` label.

description.description: One-line human summary, shown by `pvm list` / template listings. Optional.

image_name.description: Base image to build from, e.g. `debian:13`. The ansible_os_family (Debian/Suse/RedHat) is DERIVED from this string and keys the shared cache's package + dotfiles overlays. An unsupported base (e.g. alpine) is rejected at provision time.

tz.description: Container timezone. `host` = match the host's timezone.

runtimes.description: OCI runtimes this template supports. `crun` shares the host kernel (default); `libkrun` is a microVM (stronger isolation; a later pvm addition). `pvm --runtime <x>` must be one of these.

distro_package_groups.description: Named package bundles from `roles/provision_distro_packages/defaults/main.yml`, referenced by short name. Resolved against this image's ansible_os_family (`__common__` + the per-family overlay) - the SAME registry ivm/qvm use.

distro_packages.description: Extra packages, literal names for this image's distro (e.g. `links2`). Flat - the image already pins one distro.

thirdparty_software.description: Named non-distro install recipes from `roles/provision_thirdparty_software/defaults/main.yml` (e.g. `agent_claude`, `agent_codex`). Run as part of the build provision step, resolved per ansible_os_family (family entry else `__common__`).

dotfiles.description: Dotfile sets staged host-side from the shared cache and COPYd into the image. Config only; the program itself (e.g. emacs) must be in distro_package_groups / distro_packages.

hide_dirs.description: Subpaths under the cwd mount masked with an empty read-only dir, so the container (e.g. an AI agent) cannot see the host's real `.git` history / `.vscode` autorun. Set `[]` to disable.

publish_ports.description: podman `--publish` specs, e.g. `1455:1455/tcp`. Bound at run time.

agent.description: Optional agent the container exists to run; `pvm agent` execs `command` as the unprivileged user.

command.description: The command `pvm agent` runs in the container (e.g. `claude`).

display_name.description: Human label for the agent (e.g. `Claude Code`).

auth_note.description: Optional one-line note shown after init about completing auth.

post_install_script.description: Shell run as ROOT in the build container after packages + thirdparty install (before commit). Use `su - user -c '...'` to act as the unprivileged user.
